verdict.rationale: Featurebase is a SaaS feedback and support platform that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a JS/React SDK, REST APIs (Reports, Training Data, Help Center edit endpoints), webhooks and an llms.txt, but nothing mentions a command-line tool. SDKs and APIs are developer building blocks, not an official CLI, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
